disposition_reason: Behavioral and neural prediction are ordered tasks, but the exact published run, evaluated support and baseline version are unresolved. The source reports conflicting lateral speed correlations; current full-support protected components amend the historical first-200 support. These cannot certify surpassing the source task.

source_paper.title: Neuroformer: Multimodal and Multitask Generative Pretraining for Brain Data

evidence.supports: Primary arXiv v4 reports lateral/medial speed correlations, few-shot data budgets and multimodal ablations.
Verifies canonical publication identity and neural-prediction/pretraining/behavior scope; the large linked PDF was not downloaded in this curation.
Source samples random interval subsets, names 10 ms neural and 50 ms behavioral files, and returns data/interval support. Actual published split identities are not saved here.

evidence.locator: load_visnav, NFDataloader setup, behavior decoding and lines 225-234
evidence.supports: Released plotting path computes Pearson correlation from the first 200 behavior predictions; this does not authenticate Table 1 support.
Author route supplies lateral Visnav and V1AL recipes, with modality options requiring exact per-result binding.

evidence.locator: Primary-source table inspection retained by the repository, page 8, Table 1
evidence.supports: Earlier direct PDF audit records proceedings lateral/medial .97/.97 versus arXiv v4 .95/.97; cause and source-run mapping remain unresolved. This retained audit is not a fresh PDF inspection.

evidence.locator: Historical/protected comparison; Published target versus benchmark target
evidence.supports: The component preserves all 46 slots/85 condition cells, distinguishes source-amended support, and has no scientific qualification.

target.description: Source neural response generation and behavior decoding, including speed, gaze, full-data/few-shot pretraining and modality ablations; speed alone must not silently replace this original family.

dataset.description: Visnav lateral/medial and Passive-Stim sources are identified, but immutable released file identities and their exact joins to published runs remain unverified.

cohort.description: Paper describes lateral 2022-neuron and medial 1905-neuron Visnav recordings and 386-neuron Passive-Stim data. Animal/session identities and published exclusions must be bound; neurons and time windows are not independent animals.

split.description: Pinned loader randomly selects 80% of intervals and takes a training subset for fine-tuning; exact seed/order/published split is unbound. A new contiguous partition with guard bands is an extension, not the original split.

inputs.description: Neural spikes, stimulus video and behavior modalities vary by source condition. Authenticate each condition’s visible modalities, pretraining/label budget and target visibility; a target appearing through another input invalidates the comparison.

preprocessing.description: Paper describes deconvolved calcium activity. Released Visnav neural and behavior files have distinct 0.01/0.05 s clocks; original tokenization, windows, time alignment and author configuration must be joined to each result.

metric.description: Table 1 behavioral regression uses Pearson r, sum((y-y_mean)*(prediction-prediction_mean))/sqrt(sum((y-y_mean)^2)*sum((prediction-prediction_mean)^2)). Undefined constant-series values cannot be replaced by a success score. Neural/classification metrics remain separately required.

aggregation.description: The released inference plot uses first 200 rows per behavior mode; publication support and pooling/seed aggregation are not authenticated. Do not substitute full-support r or average speed and gaze.

comparison.primary_metric: Source-version-bound behavior Pearson r and separately bound original neural-prediction/ablation endpoints; full-family decision unresolved

published_baseline.description: arXiv v4 Table 1 gives lateral/medial Neuroformer r=.95/.97; the retained proceedings PDF audit gives .97/.97. No single lateral target or complete-family aggregate is selected; neither table is an executed local result.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No qualified rerun is established. Source code and a comparison component do not authenticate the paper checkpoint, training recipe, evaluated rows or baseline outcome.

minimum_effect.rationale: A task-specific increase in correlation must be justified on the fixed paper support after resolving version and calibration. No arbitrary correlation margin is supplied.

uncertainty.method: Specify paired temporal dependence-aware uncertainty and seed replication after recovering original recording identities and support; do not treat adjacent windows or neurons as independent subjects.
uncertainty.independent_unit: recording/animal where identifiable; temporal blocks only for within-recording conditional uncertainty
uncertainty.rationale: Primary data are temporally dependent and biological replication is not established by the lateral/medial labels. Neither one seed nor first-200 correlation supplies a valid generalization uncertainty rule.

paper_win_requires: Resolve the canonical paper version discrepancy and authenticate per-result author run/checkpoint/configuration and metric support.
Preserve original recording cohorts, exact splits, input clocks/windows, visible modalities and full-data/1%/10% budgets for each source condition.
Retain all original registered endpoint families; a gain on one lateral speed cell cannot be promoted to full-paper success.
Reproduce the authenticated author baseline as calibration, then freeze the candidate and compare on that same original support under declared budgets.
Treat new guarded chronological splits, full-row protected Pearson and altered generated-history paths as separate extensions unless exact original-task equivalence is proved.
Require a justified meaningful effect and prespecified dependence-aware uncertainty; report source score, rerun score and any future SOTA score separately.

current_sota.description: No present-day SOTA comparator has been source-verified. The paper’s own comparator rows are historical baselines.

episode.improvement_loop: Held until original run/support identities are resolved. Then allow matched training and validation feedback, retaining per-condition pretraining and label budgets and logging all checkpoint selection.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze source code, weights/pretraining provenance, selected source conditions, configuration, preprocessing, seeds and prediction ordering before final access.
episode.final_evaluation: Require matched original ordered support and a qualified operator evaluator for every claimed source condition. Existing protected all-row components cannot directly compare to historical first-200 scores.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep version-specific published targets, authenticated author reruns and any separately verified SOTA distinct. Local recipes and source-amended metrics cannot replace the source baseline.

blocking_issues: Published lateral Table 1 discrepancy and exact run/support mapping remain unresolved.
Immutable data identities, original split realization, biological identities, modality visibility and all source condition recipes remain unbound.
No executed authenticated reference or qualified final evaluator for the complete original task.
Meaningful effect, dependence-aware uncertainty and concrete access/compute budgets are not frozen.

legacy.notes: Retain registered-runtime and scientific-contract evidence, version-specific targets and all original scope cells. Historical replay is calibration; amended protected support and generated examples are not a paper-win grader.
